title: Children's Book Metadata Schema
description: Schema for metadata.json files describing a single children's book in the design system.

title.description: Book title as it will appear on the cover.

book_id.description: URL/folder-safe unique identifier, matching the book's directory name.

age_range.description: Target developmental age range in years.

developmental_focus.description: Primary developmental goal, e.g. 'visual contrast tracking', 'emotional vocabulary', 'fine-motor sequencing'.

min_point_size.description: Minimum body text size in points; kept large for early-reader/adult-read-aloud legibility.

total_pages.description: Total page count including cover, matching the manuscript.md breakdown.

color_palette.description: Name of the palette used from shared_assets/color_palettes/palettes.json.

safety_notes.description: Age-appropriate content safety notes (e.g. no small-parts imagery, no ambiguous facial expressions).
